claims.summary: The V0.16.93 production Smart Sync replay exposed a recoverable local-save retry that was briefly presented as a permanent failure during deterministic grading.
Save presentation now follows generation, Smart Sync, the settle-aware regrade handoff, verification, and grading.
An active local retry remains neutral, while a local error that survives the complete workflow still becomes a visible failure.
Compiler activity never defers a cloud save failure, and focused tests pin all persistence presentation boundaries.
The patch changes save-status truth only and adds no model, compiler-quality, instructor, factual, accessibility, classroom, or paid-model claim.
